tool.name: Beacon2 Runs
tool.description: retrieve sequencing runs from federated beacons or a self-hosted database
tool.command: #if str($connection.transport) == "api" #set $filters = $connection.filters beacon2-query entity --entity run @PROVIDER_ARGS@ --granularity '$connection.granularity' --limit $connection.pagination.limit --skip $connection.pagination.skip #if str($connection.pagination.sample) --sample $connection.pagination.sample #end if #if str($connection.lookup.mode) == "by_id" --entity-id '$connection.lookup.entity_id' #end if @FILTER_ARGS@ @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #else beacon2-query entity --entity run --transport mongodb --db-host '$connection.db_host' --db-port $connection.db_port --database '$connection.database' --collection '$connection.collection' --credentials-file '$credentials' #if str($connection.mongo_fields.identification) --entity-id '$connection.mongo_fields.identification' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.individualId) --field 'individualId=$connection.mongo_fields.individualId' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.libraryLayout) --field 'libraryLayout=$connection.mongo_fields.libraryLayout' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.librarySelection) --field 'librarySelection=$connection.mongo_fields.librarySelection' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.librarySource) --field 'librarySource.label=$connection.mongo_fields.librarySource' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.libraryStrategy) --field 'libraryStrategy=$connection.mongo_fields.libraryStrategy' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.platform) --field 'platform=$connection.mongo_fields.platform' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.platformModel) --field 'platformModel.label=$connection.mongo_fields.platformModel' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.runDate) --field 'runDate=$connection.mongo_fields.runDate' #end if @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #end if

param.name: entity_id
param.label: Identifier
param.help: As used by that beacon. Identifiers are local to each beacon.

section.name: mongo_fields
section.title: Fields to match (each one exact; all must match)

param.name: individualId
param.label: INDIVIDUAL ID
param.help: Reference to the individual ID, e.g. TCGA-AO-A0JJ Matched exactly against individualId.

param.name: libraryLayout
param.label: LIBRARY LAYOUT
param.help: Ontology value for the library layout e.g 'PAIRED', 'SINGLE' Matched exactly against libraryLayout.

param.name: librarySelection
param.label: LIBRARY SELECTION
param.help: Selection method for library preparation, e.g 'RANDOM', 'RT-PCR' Matched exactly against librarySelection.

param.name: librarySource
param.label: LIBRARY SOURCE
param.help: Ontology value for the source of the sequencing or hybridization library, e.g 'genomic source', 'transcriptomic source' Matched exactly against librarySource.label.

param.name: libraryStrategy
param.label: LIBRARY STRATEGY
param.help: Library strategy, e.g. 'WGS' Matched exactly against libraryStrategy.

param.name: platform
param.label: PLATFORM
param.help: General platform technology label where the specific model is not relevant, e.g. Illumina Matched exactly against platform.

param.name: platformModel
param.label: PLATFORM MODEL
param.help: Ontology value for experimental platform or methodology used, e.g. 'Illumina HiSeq 3000' Matched exactly against platformModel.label.

param.name: runDate
param.label: RUN DATE
param.help: Date at which the experiment was performed Matched exactly against runDate.

tool.help:
**What it does**
@HELP_READS@
Retrieves run records from the beacons you select, or from a self-hosted Beacon MongoDB database.
**Two ways to narrow a query, one per connection**
On the *Beacon v2 API* the tool takes **filters**: ontology terms such as ``NCIT:C3058``, which each beacon maps onto its own records. The API has no way to match a field's value directly.
On a *self-hosted MongoDB* the tool takes **fields**: the same named fields the 2.2.x tools offered, each matched exactly against a document path shown in its help. A raw collection has no mapping from ontology terms to fields, so filters are not offered there.
@HELP_OUTPUTS@
